2607.13587.title: From Prediction to Collaboration: Interactive Symbolic Music Analysis
2607.13587.paper_summary: Automatic symbolic music analysis has made substantial progress, yet existing systems are typically designed for a single mode of use, such as full-score prediction, and therefore do not match the broader range of operations that arise in analysis workflows, including partial completion, local correction, and iterative refinement. As a result, there remains a gap between strong benchmark models and systems that can support interactive analytical use. We present a unified framework for symbolic Roman-numeral (RN) analysis that narrows this gap by combining strong predictive performance with direct support for constrained completion and revision. The method is designed to provide a practical trade-off between accuracy and interactive responsiveness by computing expensive pretrained representations once and reusing them during iterative refinement, making powerful pretrained models more amenable to interactive settings. It supports complete score analysis, targeted revision of existing labels, and inference of missing annotations from partial context through a shared modeling framework. Experiments on Dilemmadata, the largest and most heterogeneous benchmark of its kind, show that the proposed approach is a strong RN-analysis baseline while also supporting masked completion from partial labels. Together with a prototype interface for multi-level candidate inspection and editing, these results position automatic RN analysis not only as a prediction problem, but also as a foundation for future interactive tools for music analysis.
2607.13587.paper_summary_zh: 自動符號音樂分析已取得重大進展，然而現有系統通常設計為單一使用模式，例如全譜預測，因此無法滿足分析工作流程中出現的更廣泛操作，包括部分完成、本地修正和迭代精煉。結果，強大的基準模型與能夠支持互動分析使用的系統之間仍存在差距。我們提出了一個統一的符號羅馬數字（RN）分析框架，通過結合強大的預測性能與對受限完成和修訂的直接支持來縮小這一差距。該方法旨在通過一次計算昂貴的預訓練表示並在迭代精煉過程中重用它們，提供準確性與互動響應性之間的實用權衡，使強大的預訓練模型更適合於互動環境。它支持完整譜分析、對現有標籤的針對性修訂，以及通過共享建模框架從部分上下文推斷缺失的註釋。在Dilemmadata上進行的實驗，這是同類中最大且最異質的基準，顯示所提出的方法是強大的RN分析基線，同時也支持從部分標籤進行掩碼完成。結合一個多層候選檢查和編輯的原型界面，這些結果將自動RN分析定位為不僅僅是一個預測問題，而是未來音樂分析互動工具的基礎。
